## Intermediate Plot

Explore foundational plots grouped by data type and relationship

---

### ▸ Categorical Plots

Includes: Lollipop, Cleveland Dot, Mosaic, Radial Bar
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](moderate/2.1_categorical_intermediate.qmd)

---

### ▸ Continuous Plots

Includes: Violin plots, Ridgeline plots, 2D density, Hexbin
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](moderate/2.2_continuous_intermediate.qmd)

---

### ▸ Category vs. Continuous

Includes:
- Violin plots,
- Ridgeline plots,
- Bee swarm plots,
- Raincloud plots,
- Enhanced grouped/stacked bars
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](moderate/2.3_category_vs_continuous_intermediate.qmd)

---

### ▸ Time

Includes:
- Smoothed trends (LOESS, moving average)
- Area charts with confidence bands
- Multi-series comparison plots
- Annotations and event markers, Seasonal patterns
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](moderate/2.4_timeseries_intermediate.qmd)

### ▸ Relational flow

Includes:
- Network diagrams (nodes & edges)
- Sankey diagrams (flow)
- Chord diagrams (circular relationships)
- Alluvial plots (categorical flows)
- Correlation networks
🔗 [View Slide Deck →](moderate/2.5_relational_flow_intermediate.qmd)

### ▸ Geographical

Includes:
- Choropleth maps (filled regions)
- Point/bubble maps
- Heat maps (density)
- Faceted maps (small multiples)
- Interactive maps
🔗 [View Slide Deck](moderate/2.6_geographic_intermediate.qmd)

## Self-check quiz

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../assets/quiz.R")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
quiz_mcq("pm1", "Twenty hospitals each have one readmission rate. Which plot ranks them clearly with little ink?",
         c("A chord diagram of the twenty hospitals", "A Cleveland dot plot or lollipop chart", "A 2D density plot of the twenty rates", "A radial bar chart with stacked layers"), answer = 2,
         explain = "One value per category, ranked: a sorted dot or lollipop plot uses position, which we read most accurately.")
quiz_mcq("pm2", "Thousands of age–SBP pairs overlap into a solid block. Which plot shows where points are dense?",
         c("A pie chart of age groups", "A lollipop chart of each pair", "A hexbin or 2D density plot", "A chord diagram of the pairs"), answer = 3,
         explain = "Hexbins and 2D densities count points per area, so dense regions stand out instead of hiding under each other.")
quiz_mcq("pm3", "Patients move from referral stage to treatment outcome. Which plot shows those flows?",
         c("A Sankey or alluvial plot", "A ridgeline plot of stages", "A choropleth of the stages", "A hexbin plot of each stage"), answer = 1,
         explain = "Sankey and alluvial plots draw flows between stages with widths proportional to the number of patients.")
```
